A twelve-[[Standard year/Legends|year]]-old [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Gender/Legends|girl]] named [[Alysssa Maggrit]] ran a numbers racket for her '''uncle''' in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Tolea Biqua]] above the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] at the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In a failed effort to publicly reveal on the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] the true name of the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[alyssa]]roxu, inept fellow slicer [[wampa1]] mistakenly identified her as Alysssa Maggrit, thus inadvertently blowing Maggrit's cover. Alyssaroxu speculated that Maggrit's uncle would enact vengeance on wampa1 for doing so.
